summary: I implemented every stub in src/jinja2/environment.py, including the module helpers, the Environment and Template methods, the TemplateModule, TemplateExpression and TemplateStream classes, and the private helpers the code depended on (_load_template, Template._from_namespace, _get_default_module_async). The file byte-compiles under the jail Python 3.10, but no test run completed because src/jinja2/nodes.py line 80 uses a nested-quote f-string that only parses on Python 3.12+, so the package does not import and passed and failed are reported as -1.
